cases.title: Toggle Text Box Visibility
cases.description: Preconditions: The Speech Text Reader is loaded and the text box (data-testid='text-box') is initially hidden. Steps: Click the toggle button (data-testid='toggle-button'). Expected Behavior: The text box appears by adding the 'show' class. Click the toggle button again to hide it and verify the 'show' class is removed.

cases.title: Close Text Box via Close Button
cases.description: Preconditions: The text box (data-testid='text-box') is visible. Steps: Click the 'Close' button (data-testid='close-button'). Expected Behavior: The text box is hidden by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Open
cases.description: Preconditions: The text box is initially hidden. Steps: Click the toggle button (data-testid='toggle-button') to make the text box visible, and verify that the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') is populated with option elements representing available voices and languages retrieved via speechSynthesis.getVoices().

cases.title: Select Voice from Dropdown
cases.description: Preconditions: The text box is open and the voice dropdown is populated. Steps: Select a specific voice option (e.g., containing 'US' or 'CN') from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select'). Expected Behavior: The selected voice is successfully assigned as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Read Text Aloud from Textarea
cases.description: Preconditions: The text box is open, a voice is selected, and text is entered into the textarea (data-testid='text-area'). Steps: Click the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'). Expected Behavior: The system reads the entered text aloud using the selected voice.

cases.title: Interact with Predefined Phrase Box
cases.description: Preconditions: The application is loaded with dynamically generated predefined phrase boxes containing an image and paragraph. Steps: Click on a phrase box. Expected Behavior: The system reads the associated text aloud via the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box with the active class for 800 milliseconds.

opinions.feedback: All cases are fully grounded in their respective requirements, with clear preconditions, actionable steps, and verifiable expected behaviors. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: Analyzed 6 requirements for unit e2edev_bench_04 covering text box visibility toggling, close button functionality, voice dropdown population, voice selection handling, speech synthesis reading from textarea, and predefined phrase box interactions with speech and visual highlighting.
